_comment: Evolution on SimScale, STEP air-volume route (simscale_step_eval.py). Keys: export SIMSCALE_API_KEYS='k1,k2,...' (never in a file in the repo). Each key runs at most runs_per_key cars, then the next key is used; when all are used the campaign waits (`python campaign.py tick <dir>` reports it). Every car, the team's included, goes through the same route: exact CAD outside the sidepod region, the pod as ~4500 triangles, exact wheels, road 0.15 mm under the wheels. The winners are re-timed in our OpenFOAM pipeline on GitHub Actions (stage recheck).
_rules: Design rules (CarSpec switches): no virtual cargo; nothing in the sidepod region above 27.175 mm (the team STEP's sidepod top; also used for the T4.4.2 halo cap, which the STEP itself reaches); milled from top and bottom only (3.175 mm ball); 3 mm minimum walls; no loose pieces; sidepod region only.
_comment_scratch: cma_scratch (2026-11-22): CMA from no sidepod (seed 'lean'), 8x3x4 lattice. With amp 12 it could only grow a skin within ~12 mm of the spine (15-18 g foam), so it stops after its first 8 and cma_scratch2 (amp 24 mm, up to ~22 g, 7/8 legal offline) carries on. The first CMA (from the team's pod) is frozen at 105 runs after plateauing.
_comment_budget: 2026-11-22 user: the layout evolution gets most of keys 2+3; cma_scratch2 stops at 32 runs (4 generations).
